headings.usage: Use for all page titles, card headers, and KPI values. Tracking tight (-0.02em).

mono.usage: Use for Ticket IDs, IP addresses, and Timestamps.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize Dark Mode: Ensure 'dark' class is applied to the root element by default.
Use 'Sistem Tiketing & SLA Control' as the app title.
Login Page: Split screen. Left side form (glassmorphic), Right side image (Data Center with overlay).
Dashboard: Implement Role-Based Rendering (Admin, AM, Helpdesk, EOS, Client).
EOS Logbook: Mobile-first design. Large touch targets for photo upload.
Restitution Calculator: Use a specialized card with real-time calculation fields.
Navigation: Sidebar for desktop, Bottom nav for mobile (EOS/Helpdesk).
Notification: Use a bell icon with a red dot for real-time WebSocket alerts.
Use Lucide-React icons: 'Camera' for CCTV, 'Server' for Internet, 'Megaphone' for Speaker.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖 etc.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
